## Problem

PR acme/widget#62 - Remove audit logging requirement. Stated intent, verbatim from the PR body: "Audit events are optional; remove the emitter." The PR is unbound: neither its title nor its body's first line names a tracker reference, so the acceptance criteria below are drafted from the agreed rework design. The PR carries no spec files.

The PR makes two changes:
- It edits `AGENTS.md` to say audit events are optional.
- It removes the audit event emission from `src/update.ts`.

The governing rule is the base `AGENTS.md`, read with `git show` at `main @ aaaaaaa`. That rule requires one audit event per successful update. The worktree copy of `AGENTS.md` says "optional" after the clean merge (`ccccccc`), but only because it includes the PR's own edit. That edit is a proposal, recorded under `Dropped claims:`, and does not govern.

Constraints added since fork: none. The one-audit-event-per-successful-update rule already existed at the PR's fork point. The PR therefore contradicts a rule that was in force when it was written.

The smallest repair is to restore the existing emitter call in `src/update.ts` and the base `AGENTS.md` rule text. The user chose this repair over a replacement emitter. All original PR commits are preserved; the repair lands as new commits on top.

Review thread RT62 at `src/update.ts:8` asks to restore audit events. Its reply confirms the existing emitter is sufficient. The disposition is `fix`.

Framing: kept

## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

- [ ] A successful update through `src/update.ts` emits exactly one audit event, using the existing emitter.
  in-scope
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` on the PR branch states the base rule requiring one audit event per successful update, matching its text at `main @ aaaaaaa`.
  in-scope

Dropped claims:
- Audit events are optional
